cc:Work.dc:title: residuals
cc:Work.dc:description: Continuous-fit residuals for catalog 99999 (SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE), 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 through 2026-01-01T02:00:00+00:00. Delivery: accepted. Residuals are predicted minus supplied states. R points along the supplied TEME position, N along its position–velocity cross product, and T=N×R. Velocity is the norm of the TEME velocity difference, not a derivative in rotating RTN. Statistics include every in-window sample with equal validation weight; the 3D position RMS is not per-axis RMS. The fit's RMS gate is not an instantaneous error bound.
